title: Learning resolves a class-forced pair only by winding
claim: Only surfaces with Euler characteristic 0 let a law and a state be free of dissonance (no violated line, no over-agreeing face, no even face). On such a surface, for a Kasteleyn law in a sign class no state satisfies, a state with one violated line has exactly one over-agreeing face, and with the state fixed, learning steps at the dissonance (A26) resolve the pair: one re-signing at the violated line and two holes walked along the arcs of a cheapest perfect matching. Every process that resolves it, whatever the state does, changes the law by a cycle of nonzero homology class, so it winds around a handle and changes at least as many signs as the smallest cycle in that class. Checked on the two Fano tori and 57 thin tori of even index up to 40 points (96,732 walks into every other class, all resolved and winding). Computed: the cheapest walk into each class meets the lower bound exactly on every torus; a local rule with an outside distance to the over-agreeing face resolved all 9,608 starts. Stress test: the sphere's no-reversal rule reached 300 of 300 targets on K_14 and K_16 and 2,698 of 2,700 on nine non-octahedral spheres.
failure_conditions: A resolving walk whose sign change is a boundary.
A least state of a class-forced law with no resolving walk.
A walk with fewer sign changes than the smallest cycle of its class change.
foundation_claim_scope: Kasteleyn knot laws on lattice tori whose class no state satisfies (the Fano tori and thin tori of even index up to 40 points); the learner of A26; dissonance read as in A46. Theorem 3.2 holds on every closed surface with Euler characteristic 0 for any process.
